title: Species: they differ in needs, not stats

foodSource.description: "blood", "none" (eats nothing from the stores) or an item id

tires.description: false: never tires or sleeps; rest stays full (ADR-0022)

needs.description: Needs from needs.json that this species' nature adds to food, rest and company (ADR-0022)

unsettlesForDays.description: For this many days after they arrive, the living take less warmth from talking with them and feel uneasy

arrivalKey.description: How their arrival reads (a loc key with {a}); omit for the wanderer's line

refusesWork.description: Work their nature will not do, whatever their priorities say

cannotLie.description: They say hard truths where others insult, and repay what they owe before anything else

grudgeDecayEveryDays.description: Grudges they hold fade a point only every this many days

rhythm.description: The kind of day they keep (rhythms.json); omit for diurnal if they tire, sleepless if not (ADR-0029)
